jobs.description: Job Description About Kapaya Most organizations do not struggle with ambition. They struggle with execution.Processes are often spread across disconnected tools, manual work slows teams down, and important operational workflows are not always designed to scale.That is where Kapaya comes in.We help organizations improve how work gets done by designing better operational structures, building connected systems and implementing workflows that are clear, practical and scalable. Using tools such as Airtable, Make and AI-enabled workflows, we help customers move from complexity to clarity.Kapaya is part of One Productivity Group, a pan-European group focused on improving how organizations operate. Across our brands, consulting, technology and execution come together to create better workflows, stronger collaboration and more scalable operations. About the role This role is for someone who enjoys translating complexity into practical systems.As a Solution Engineer, you work with customers who want to improve the way their operations are structured and delivered. The starting point is often a workflow that has grown over time, depends on manual work, or is spread across too many disconnected tools. Your role is to understand that setup, identify what can be improved and build solutions that make operations more effective and scalable.The role combines analysis, solution design, implementation and customer guidance. It moves between understanding the current state, building structured solutions in Airtable, creating automations in Make and helping customers make these new ways of working successful in practice.It is hands-on, client-facing and focused on creating real operational improvement.Your mission What the role involves • Analyzing existing customer processes, workflows and system setups • Designing and implementing structured solutions in Airtable • Building automations and integrations using Make • Supporting the development of AI-enabled workflows and practical AI use cases where relevant • Translating business needs into scalable systems and operational setups • Advising customers on how to improve existing workflows, tools and ways of working • Identifying optimization opportunities in current customer environments and turning them into concrete improvements • Supporting customers during implementation and helping new structures and systems land successfully in practice • Working confidently with customers to explain solutions, guide decisions and build trust • Contributing to internal standards, scalable delivery approaches and better ways of building customer solutionsYour profile What makes a strong fit • Experience with Airtable, Make and/or AI-related workflows • Experience in solution engineering, implementation, process improvement or a related field is a strong advantage • Strong communication and presentation skills • Fluent German and English, both spoken and written • A structured and practical way of working • Customer orientation, initiative and a collaborative mindset • Confidence in working directly with customers and guiding them through change • The ability to identify inefficiencies and translate them into workable solutions • Comfort with flexible team structures and fast-moving environments • Willingness to travel occasionally and work on-site with customers when needed is a plus What makes this role interesting Many technical roles focus only on the build. Many consulting roles focus only on the advice. This role sits in between.It involves understanding how organizations work in practice, identifying where systems and workflows can be improved, and building solutions that make day-to-day operations more structured and effective.The impact is visible. Not in theory, but in better workflows, clearer systems and less manual complexity for the customer.Why One Productivity Group? What One Productivity Group offers • A role with real ownership and direct customer impact • The opportunity to work on meaningful workflow, automation and operational improvement challenges • A flexible setup, remote, hybrid or from one of our office locations • A professional onboarding and strong on-the-job learning environment • Regular coaching, feedback and development opportunities • A team that combines high standards with a collaborative and down-to-earth way of working • Room to bring in ideas, improve solutions and contribute beyond the core role • A digital-first work culture with flexibility and trust • High-quality equipment for both office and remote work About One Productivity Group One Productivity Group is a fast-growing pan-European group focused on helping organizations improve the way they work. Across our brands, consulting, technology and execution come together to create better workflows, stronger collaboration and more scalable operations.We hire across Europe and work across multiple countries, including Germany, the Netherlands, Switzerland, France and Sweden. Our people work from offices in Berlin, Hamburg, Rotterdam, Paris and Stockholm, or fully remotely. This gives us the flexibility to bring together the right talent across markets while staying connected through shared standards, close collaboration and a strong team culture.There is a shared culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement. Job Description About Bluehive Most organizations do not struggle with tools. They struggle with how work actually flows.Too many processes, unclear ownership, and teams working next to each other instead of together.That is where Bluehive comes in.We help organizations bring structure into the way they work. Using platforms like Asana, but more importantly by designing workflows, aligning teams and making sure changes actually stick in practice.Bluehive is part of One Productivity Group, a pan-European group focused on improving how organizations operate. Across our brands, consulting, technology and execution come together to create better workflows, stronger collaboration and more scalable operations. About the role This role is for someone who enjoys understanding customer challenges, identifying opportunities and turning them into meaningful business relationships.As an Account Executive, you help organizations recognize where their current ways of working create friction and where better workflows, clearer structures and stronger collaboration can make a real difference. You guide prospects through that journey, from first conversation to closing, by combining commercial drive with a strong understanding of customer needs.The role sits at the intersection of business development, consultative sales and organizational improvement. You work closely with SDRs, consultants and solution colleagues to shape opportunities, build trust with stakeholders and help customers move confidently toward the right decision.It is a commercial role, but one built on substance, credibility and long-term value.Your mission What the role involves • Leading sales conversations with prospective customers and understanding how their current processes, tools and ways of working are set up • Identifying challenges around collaboration, ownership, structure and operational efficiency • Showing how Bluehive’s solutions can help organizations work in a more structured, aligned and scalable way • Managing opportunities independently throughout the full sales cycle, from qualification to negotiation and closing • Building relationships with internal champions, decision-makers and senior stakeholders across customer organizations • Working closely with SDRs, consultants and solution colleagues to shape strong and realistic solution directions • Guiding customers through decision-making processes with clarity, confidence and commercial ownership • Keeping pipeline, CRM data and sales information well structured and up to date • Creating repeatable and consistent ways of working that support predictable commercial results • Contributing to the further development of messaging, sales approaches and commercial best practicesYour profile What makes a strong fit • Several years of experience in sales, business development, account management or a similar commercial role • Ideally experience in SaaS, consulting, digital collaboration or solution-based selling • Strong communication and relationship-building skills • Confidence in speaking with different stakeholders, including senior decision-makers • A structured and disciplined way of working, with strong ownership and follow-through • The ability to understand customer challenges and translate them into commercially relevant opportunities • A proactive mindset and the ability to work independently in a dynamic environment • A high level of customer focus, credibility and professional presence • Fluent German and English, both spoken and written • Interest in work management, process improvement and modern collaboration tools such as Asana is a strong advantage What makes this role interesting Many sales roles focus mainly on volume, speed and short-term targets. This role goes further.It involves understanding how organizations actually operate, where collaboration breaks down and how better workflows and structures can create real improvement.That makes the conversations more meaningful, the sales process more consultative and the impact of the role more visible.Why One Productivity Group? Our SOMANET, Circulo and ACTILINK product lines integrate drives, sensors and control electronics into compact, highly efficient units, deployed in some of the most demanding robotics programmes globally.As Hardware Developer you will help create our next-generation robotic axis controller. jobs.employer_name: Weierstraß-Institut für Angewandte Analysis und Stochastik (WIAS)
jobs.description: The Weierstrass Institute for Applied Analysis and Stochastics (WIAS) is an institute of the Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V. (FVB). The FVB comprises seven non-university research institutes in Berlin which are funded by the federal and state governments. The research institutes belong to the Leibniz Association.WIAS invites applications for aResearch Assistant Position (f/m/d)(Ref. 26/22)in the Research Group “Nonsmooth Variational Problems and Operator Equations”(Head: Prof. Dr. Michael Hintermüller),starting on January 1, 2027.Field of work:The successful candidate will work in the MATH+ project "DOC-TWIN: Duality-Based Error Control for Optimal Control Problems in Digital-Twin-Based Structural Health Monitoring". The project aims at developing a convex-duality-based framework for reliable error control in PDE-constrained optimal control problems motivated by digital-twin-based structural health monitoring.The Tasks include:- Developing and analyzing duality-based a posteriori error identities for PDE-constrained optimal control problems;- Deriving corresponding discrete a priori error identities and using them for convergence-rate analysis and certified nonlinear solver control;- Designing, implementing, and numerically validating finite element methods, including adaptive mesh-refinement strategies and suitable post-processing techniques;- Preparing scientific publications and presenting the results at workshops and conferences.**We are looking for: **Applicants with:- A very good university degree in mathematics, computational science, engineering, or a closely related field;- A strong interest in numerical analysis, optimization, partial differential equations, or scientific computing;- A willingness to work on both the mathematical analysis and the implementation of numerical methods for PDE-constrained optimization problems;- Good communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment;- Good written and spoken English skills.Desirable Qualifications:Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage but not a requirement:- Finite element methods, adaptive methods, or a posteriori error estimation;- Convex analysis, nonsmooth optimization, or optimal control;- PDE-constrained optimization or inverse problems;- Numerical methods for elasticity, structural mechanics, or related models;- Implementation of numerical methods in Python, MATLAB, Julia, C/C++, or finite element software.What we offer:- The opportunity to work at WIAS Berlin, a leading research institution with strengths in partial differential equations, mathematical modeling, nonlinear optimization, and applied mathematics in general;- The option of mobile working;- A certified family-friendly work environment (Audit berufundfamilie);- The opportunity to live and work in Berlin, one of the world's most culturally rich and diverse international cities. Berlin offers a wide range of opportunities to enjoy life outside work while remaining relatively affordable compared with other major cities. Neither the position nor living in Berlin requires knowledge of German, although WIAS offers free German courses. We particularly welcome international applicants. Berlin also offers a rich scientific landscape, with numerous research opportunities and career prospects in both academia and industry;- Close mentorship from the supervisor and other peers through a dedicated mentorship program.Please direct scientific queries to Prof Dr. Michael Hintermüller (michael.hintermueller@wias-berlin.de).The appointment is limited to two years. The position is full-time (39 hours per week), with a salary based on pay grade E 13 of the German TVöD Bund pay scale.WIAS is committed to fostering diversity and equal opportunities and particularly encourages women to apply. Applicants with disabilities will be given preferential consideration in cases of equal qualification. If you have any questions or want to provide us with information related to diversity, inclusion or disabilities, please feel free to consult our website orcontact our Diversity Officer, Sara Krummenacher (sara.krummenacher@wias-berlin.de).How to apply:Please upload your complete application documents (motivation letter, detailed CV, certificates, copy of the master thesis, etc.) via our applicant portal using the button “Apply online”.The application period opens immediately and remains open until the position is filled.We are looking forward to your application!

jobs.occupation: Program Manager – Project Digitalization & Data Integration (f/m/d) (IT-Manager/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join us in transforming how our EPC projects access and use information. Working with engineering, procurement, logistics and site teams, as well as process and tool owners, you will identify how information is created, exchanged and used across the project lifecycle and turn project needs into connected digital workflows. You will lead BIM Recalibration@GS SO, advance reliable information flows and digital interfaces, and drive adoption of improved ways of working. Alongside this, you will steer our broader data integration activities, provide clear business direction and align the roadmap with the overarching GS Data Backbone initiative. Your work will enable project teams and operational BIM Managers through consistent practices, trusted information and practical digital solutions.How You’ll Make an Impact * Identify and prioritize information management use cases and project information needs, mapping information producers, consumers, source systems and exchange points along the EPC project lifecycle* Lead BIM Recalibration@GS SO and translate its outcomes into practical, repeatable processes and workflows with clear responsibilities and handovers, embedding improved ways of working across projects* Drive the continuous development of information management practices and information flows across the data landscape, defining requirements for reliable data flows and digital interfaces and guiding implementation with solution architects, digital teams and tool owners, grounded in ISO 19650 principles* Lead communication, training and rollout support so colleagues understand, adopt and sustain new processes and digital practices* Shape and steer GS SO's broader data integration roadmap, aligning priorities and dependencies with the GS Data Backbone initiative and connecting information management and wider EPC needs to reusable data capabilities; guide shared data definitions, cross-system mapping, source-of-truth rules, ownership and quality expectations with data owners, stewards and technical specialists* Track implementation, adoption and business benefits across both areas, using project feedback to improve processes, evaluate new integration approaches with specialists and scale proven solutionsWhat You Bring* A degree in engineering, business informatics, digitalization or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience* Several years of experience leading cross-functional programs, process improvement or data-integration initiatives, ideally in energy, engineering, construction or other complex project environments* The ability to understand what information EPC teams need, where it is created and used, and how it should move between tools and project phases, and to turn this into clear requirements and governed processes for solution architects and technical teams* A strong conceptual and practical understanding of how data is stored, connected and made usable across tools, including relational storage, knowledge graphs, tool-specific and cross-tool/domain ontologies, semantic layers, replication and ingestion, and platforms such as Snowflake* The ability to establish rules that identify the same object across systems, harmonize values, determine the valid source, validate completeness and quality, and retain traceability, alongside practical knowledge of BIM methodology and ISO 19650* Strong stakeholder and change-management skills, a structured delivery mindset, very good English and good German communication skillsAbout the TeamAt Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company.
